about: Canonical product vocabulary: one term per concept per locale. `name` is the label form (nav entry, page title, section heading); `item` is the countable noun used in running text. Anchors are message keys that must carry the term (exact, or containing it). Forbidden lists the retired synonyms per locale; `allow` names the few message values that keep one for a stated reason. Display strings only: wire values, routes and enum ids never change with this file. Guarded by src/__tests__/glossary-guard.test.ts.
